cohort: The study enrolled 120 women aged 24-38 years, with a pregnancy range of 38-42 weeks, who were undergoing elective caesarean sections with combined spinal-epidural anaesthesia.
finding: Intraoperative intravenous infusion of 250 mg aminophylline significantly reduced the incidence of post-dural puncture headache after caesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anaesthesia, with no reported side-effects.
